summary: Enclosed 809R-design steel tower eight miles west of Willits, built 1966 and closed in 1994; private land behind a locked gate, with fire cameras added in 2026.

facts.design: 809R lookout station on an enclosed 30-ft steel tower

access.note: Private land; the register says the site is 3.1 miles behind a locked gate and not open to the public.

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection - Mendocino Unit (Cal Fire MEU)

events.note: Earlier station on the same summit, described as being built in a 1932 newspaper item
James Frazier named as lookout (first named lookout in the sources read)
Bert Gibson named as fire lookout
Mrs. Russel Horn watching; lookout also served the Ground Observer Corps Skywatch program
Tower built in 1966 per the 2026 news report; the 809R design is from the register
Reopened with volunteers after state funding was lost; last staffed season in the sources read
Not staffed that fire season because of budget cuts
Permanently closed; land and structure returned to the private owner
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register
Two wildfire early-detection cameras installed; reported active March 31, 2026

notes_for_editor: Status 'standing' is from the record and the 2026 news reports (which call it a 30-foot tower); I did not visit the site. Height 30 ft converted to 9.1 m. Open question: the 1932 station versus the 1966 tower. The sources read do not say whether they are the same building; the built-1966 event cites only the 2026 news report, not a source that links the two. The Feb 2026 photo caption said the cameras would soon go in, while the 31 Mar 2026 report says they are active; the story gives both. The Forest Lookouts clippings are a secondary compilation of old newspaper items; I did not check the originals. Access changed from the record's 'unknown' to 'private' on the register's wording. Registered date from the register page (Feb 2, 2020). Fact-check 2026-10-08: the 1932, 1935, 1938, 1956, 1989 and 1990 dates were confirmed on the Forest Lookouts page and added to the evidence quotes.
